def jsp001000Statement : Prop :=
  ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ),
    (∀ x ∈ Ici (1 : ℝ), 0 ≤ F x) →
    MonotoneOn F (Ici (1 : ℝ)) →
    Tendsto F atTop atTop →
      (Erdos1195.HasErdos1195Witness F ↔
        IntegrableOn (fun x => F x / x ^ 2) (Ici (1 : ℝ)))
```

theorem jsp_001000_solved : jsp001000Statement :=
  Erdos1195.erdos_1195
```

• **Problem context**: Erdős Problem #1195 (Erdős and Graham 1980) asked for the maximum possible growth rate of the counting function $A_S(x) = \operatorname{volume}(S \cap (0, x))$ for an integer-ratio-free measurable set $S \subseteq (0, \infty)$ of infinite measure (satisfying $x/y \notin \mathbb{Z}$ for all distinct $x, y \in S$).
